name: Snow Alerts
pitch: Morning-after alerts for snow-plow contractors listing the ZIP codes that got 6 inches or more overnight, $50-100/month. Sources: the national weather feed's snowfall reports. G0 includes a 24-month backtest of alert frequency.

G0.note: daily snowfall reports live (public domain); 24-month backtest: 61 alert days, all between November and March

G1.note: snow_alert.pdf/html/csv for 2026-10-20 (2 reports) plus 2026-02-03 example (14 inches, 9 counties)

G2.note: 3 targets + drafts in outreach/; nothing sent
